summary: The assistant audited the repository by searching for FakeAgentClient/TitlebarTestHost usages, inspecting app entry points (main.ts, agent-client index, design package files, app styles), running the Svelte autofixer on three components (App.svelte, WorkspaceConfigurePanel.svelte, CommandPalette.svelte), and running pnpm check and pnpm test across the workspace. Type checking passed cleanly, but the full test run revealed 17 failing tests in apps/agent-server (run-script, extension-resources, pi-runtime-config, session-repository) while the apps/app, packages/ui, packages/protocol, and packages/extensions suites all passed. The assistant then launched three long-running subagents for test/config, frontend refactor, and backend refactor audits and continued reconnaissance on design package imports and shared Button components.

apps/app/src/main.ts uses a dev-only dynamic import of FakeAgentClient gated on import.meta.env.DEV and the ?fake query string so it never reaches production bundles.
